title: The Tools Put Back Where You Could Reach
youtube_title: The Tools Put Back Where You Could Reach | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Remembering a kindness is a way of returning it.
summary: At a harbor shelter on the lee side of the wind, Paz notices that Neighbor Sami has already taken care of a tools put back on the low peg. A quick thank-you feels too thin, so Paz does one useful thing Neighbor Sami did not ask for and then says, plainly, that they noticed.
